summary: Register Megamarket as a read-only marketplace provider using current official merchant catalog, stock and order read surfaces with explicit DBS/FBO configuration and no marketplace writes.

impacts.evidence: Merchant/scheme/warehouse configuration is host-resolved per authenticated connector account; provider code has no tenant persistence authority.
Committed fixtures are synthetic; order projection excludes buyer contact/address fields and merchant token bytes exist only inside SecretAccessor callbacks.
Task 034 adds no public TORGNEXA HTTP endpoint or OpenAPI operation.
Task 034 publishes no new EventBus or webhook schema.
Task 034 reuses existing ProductReader, InventoryReader and OrderReader SDK-v1 capability surfaces without changing frozen Connector/Runtime roots.
Task 034 adds no migration; connector account, mapping, sync and reconciliation persistence already exist.

Provider code has no direct network/database/filesystem/process/Core/App authority. Fixed-host requests are host-mediated, merchant token is callback-scoped, bodies are bounded and raw remote/transport text is not disclosed.
Manifest grants products.read, inventory.read and orders.read only; no product/price/stock/order mutation is admitted.
Remote reads do not directly mutate canonical state; subsequent sync application remains under existing audit/lineage rules.
goodsId/offerId/shipmentId/warehouse IDs remain remote mapping keys; product searchAfter and order offset cursors are configuration-bound.
Outbound merchant API calls use host-injected transport to fixed api.megamarket.tech; no inbound webhook capability is granted.
Auth/rate/service outcomes normalize to bounded SDK health/errors; live endpoint-specific ceilings remain staging/SLO evidence.
Suspend the connector account or remove the provider route to stop reads; no database rollback is required.
Synthetic/adversarial fixtures cover catalog, configured-warehouse stock, order pagination/PII exclusion and error handling; canonical Task-064 report passes all thirteen checks.
